description: This Java class converts Netty FullHttpResponse objects into custom HttpResponse objects for MockServer, handling headers, cookies, status, and body decoding.

classes.name: FullHttpResponseToMockServerHttpResponse
classes.description: A class that maps Netty's FullHttpResponse to a custom HttpResponse object, including headers, cookies, status, and body.

methods.name: mapFullHttpResponseToMockServerResponse
methods.description: Converts a FullHttpResponse to a MockServer HttpResponse, handling decoding and logging errors.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the status code and reason phrase in the HttpResponse based on the FullHttpResponse.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from FullHttpResponse to HttpResponse.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Extracts 'Set-Cookie' and 'Cookie' headers and decodes them into Cookies for HttpResponse.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Decodes the response body content and sets it in HttpResponse.
